explanation: OEIS A166944 (a(1) = 2; a(n) = a(n−1) + gcd(n, a(n−1)) for n even, + gcd(n−2, a(n−1)) for n odd): 'Every record of differences a(n)−a(n−1) more than 5 is the greater of twin primes.' The formal recurrence matches the definition, IsDifferenceRecord R says some d(n) = R strictly exceeds all earlier differences (n ≥ 2), and the conclusion is that R and R − 2 are prime. Faithful.
